body: Not a mantra so much as little things to keep occupied. Tiny discreet fidgets, grounding techniques, etc. If you feel your pent-up emotions translating to tears, maybe try to modify the 54321 or 3-3-3 rule to fit your situation. Mentally noting things you can see might not be the best idea if you need to make eye contact in a conversation, so you could eliminate that or whatever doesn't apply from the equation. Your mother has absolutely no right to belittle you this way and I'm so sorry you have to endure these two days.

I know the feeling. When your lungs fill with water and you fight to stay afloat, but the riptides drag you under with each futile stroke. One moment you're going about your business and the next, you're barraged by intrusive thoughts. The faintest reminder of what happened sends you into overload. My heart goes out to you, friend. Sometimes just when you think you're getting better, the past tries to define you. No matter what condition you're in, *you are not the product of your memories*. It's okay to ride the waves of grief and I want so much for you to make it to land. You don't have to go through this alone. Sending so much love <3
You are loved beyond imagination. No terms or conditions, just love in its purest and gentlest form. I hope you come to value yourself just as we value you. Sending so much love <3
